evidence_boundary: This is a revision-7 build/tool recovery contract, not a device simulation result. It preserves and hash-binds the committed R05 19/29 build failure and the immutable R06 36/37 static checker failure. R07 changes only the contradictory independent-checker runner-path-literal assertion: the independent checker may name the R07 runner for hash binding, but it may not import the runner, import or invoke subprocess, or execute any process. R07 reuses the same pinned open-source M4/Bison/Flex source trees and only the complete tree-hashed R05 SuiteSparse and Trilinos prefixes; it must not reuse the partial R05 Xyce build or any R05/R06 build or output namespace. The local AIM-Spice executable is excluded because auditable lawful license provenance is absent. A passing static contract establishes only that the recovery chain is frozen and reviewable. A later passing runner plus independent persisted-evidence check can establish only a reproducible pure-source serial Xyce binary, a scalar B-source tool self-test and parser-only frozen IGZO candidate syntax. These are not an IGZO equation, device curve, SPICE route comparison, physical parameter, experimental calibration or circuit result. M01 remains E0 until both formal open-source device-only routes and their independent persisted-evidence gate pass; C00, circuit, layout, PEX and HZO remain closed.
